trades.name: LAAF of the equal highs 23424.75
trades.quote: If we pop those equal highs on NQ, see a strong rejection, and re-offer the 420s then a rotation to 330s is in play. I would very much remain mindful of the levels on the way down, particularly 340-345 as it could terminate the full progression. This is probably the best short setup out there. It doesn’t mean it will work given how bullish this trend has been, but it would be an A+ setup it trend was at least neutral. As it is I can’t give it better than a B+.

trades.name: Short 23401 IB high remains offered
trades.quote: If we don’t even make it there, perhaps because today’s 23401 IB high remains offered, then we can reasonably expect another 363-371 test with potential for 340-345. I would consider that short but can’t give it better than a B- given the prevailing trend.

trades.name: Hold of 23340-23345
trades.quote: I would look for longs in the 340-345 area. Because we already have a wick into that area, I’ll rate it as a B setup but maybe a B+ as a LBAF. Therefore I won’t bid directly but get long if a responsive bid is seen.

trades.name: Hold of 23323.75-23328.5

If 232.75-328.5 doesn’t hold then today’s low is in play so it offers relatively tight risk. B rating
trades.stop_hint: If 232.75-328.5 doesn’t hold then today’s low is in play so it offers relatively tight risk.

trades.name: LBAF of today's low (23298.25)
trades.quote: Today’s low on NQ is very much susceptible to a LBAF. While one could argue bulls don’t want to see today’s excess negated, we have the 23281-23295 spot which had been heavily offered previously. Thos pop sellers may have turned dip buyer (it certainly seemed so today holding just above). I’ll give this an A-/B+ rating.
trades.stop_hint: We know that 323.75-328.5 and 340-345 would ultimately need to be reclaimed but if they are then we can target today’s high by Monday.
